title: Senior Solutions Consultant
searchText: Senior Solutions Consultant Flexport About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. Build the solutions to help Flexport grow The Ecosystem team’s mission is to make information exchange in global trade easy for everyone by efficiently, securely and reliably connecting the Flexport Platform with the external Global Trade Ecosystem. The opportunity: We are looking for a talented Solutions Consultant to join our team! In this role you will bridge the gap between Sales, Account Management, Global Operations, Solutions Engineers and Product Teams to ensure the successful deployment, ongoing utilization and stability of the integrations you deliver. You will: Own the end-to-end delivery for all integrations required to help onboard Flexport largest and most complex customers. This would include integrations that support all Flexport service offerings including purchase order, bookings, advanced shipping notification, shipment milestone, freight invoice, customs, and more. Drive functional requirements gathering and own defining the end to end integration requirements to meet the client’s functional needs. Be the subject matter expert and share insights about different domains of freight forwarding scenarios that might impact a given customer’s integration with business/product/tech stakeholders. Build a deep understanding of Flexport’s current tech capabilities as they relate to integrations for all modes and service types. Lead projects that can accommodate the wide variety of traditional and modern integration technologies in use by various logistics partners from flat files, EDI X12, EDIFACT, REST and SOAP APIs Work closely with Product Engineers and Integration Engineers, ensuring they have clear requirements as they engage in the technical build. Collaborate with the Account Management, Sales, and Global Operations teams to review, update and socialize SOP changes for integrated customers when required. Facilitate User Acceptance Testing across end-users both internally and externally with relevant customer resources ensuring successful testing and approval prior to integration go-live. Partner with Account Executives and sales leaders, ensuring they have full support in navigating integration related requests from their customers throughout the pre-sales process. You should have: 5+ years software or technology experience in a Solutions Consultant / Architect or similar role delivering integration solutions to enterprise systems Familiarity with any of the following: APIs, transmission protocols (FTP, SFTP, AS2, etc.) and payload / file formats (JSON, EDI, XML, delimited files, etc.) Strong analytical and problem solving skills paired with a persistent, proactive, results-oriented mindset Ownership mindset to drive improvements, influencing stakeholders across various teams and establishing informal roadmaps Work well with cross-functional teams and provide project leadership Initiative and positive attitude with a desire to learn and seek answers independently Outstanding organizational and time-management skills; excellent verbal and written communication Experience with data analytics, data manipulation and/or system integrations. Bachelor's degree in a technical field or relevant work experience Willingness to travel (up to 25%) Bonus points if you have: Prior experience in logistics and/or global trade Experience delivering solutions with enterprise iPaaS systems (i.e. Boomi) Ability to effectively drive integration efforts between Flexport, our customers and the ERP, TMS, Customs, WMS or other systems they rely on. #LI-onsite The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position in the posting's respective region. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range displayed, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and / or training. The US base salary range for this position (this does not include bonus, equity and benefits): $115,200 — $144,000 USD Commitment to Equal Opportunity At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.
